label: Q4a receiver LIKE fundsadmin 30d (receipt_actions)
sql: SELECT DISTINCT receipt_receiver_account_id AS account_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND receipt_receiver_account_id LIKE '%fundsadmin%'

label: Q4b ft_events involving the 3 wallets, 30d
sql: SELECT block_date, standard, contract_account_id, affected_account_id, involved_account_id, delta_amount, cause, status, receipt_id, token_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.ft_events` WHERE block_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (affected_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') OR involved_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near'))
